PRATING.TITLE: P-Rating System
PRATING.SUBTITLE: Crew performance rating and evaluation
PRATING.SUBTITLE_FULL: Productivity scoring foundation · P0–P8 scale · All thresholds configurable
PRATING.PRODUCTIVITY_SCALE_SUB: P0 = no output → P8 = 100% standard norms
PRATING.APPROVAL_WORKFLOW_SUB: Not calculated by scoring engine · requires multi-level manager sign-off
PRATING.P7_DESC: Requires approval from Site/Cluster Manager, Construction Head, and Division Head. Not generated by automatic PI scoring.
PRATING.P8_DESC: Same workflow as P7, plus Finance Manager approval. Awarded based on revenue, profitability, or exceptional performance evidence.
PRATING.EXAMPLE_CALCULATION_SUB: Flow Line Route Grading · Activity Master norm = 0.375 Km/hr
PRATING.CONTINUOUS_SCALE_SUB: Planned future migration · system designed to support both modes
PRATING.MIGRATION_NOTE_1: • The 0–100 continuous score maps directly to P-levels at current thresholds (e.g., score 90 = P6, score 100 = P8)
PRATING.MIGRATION_NOTE_2: • Removes step-function jumps — a crew scoring 72% gets 72, not P4 (60%) or P5 (80%)
PRATING.MIGRATION_NOTE_3: • Incentive calculations remain threshold-based OR can use the raw score directly
PRATING.MIGRATION_NOTE_4: • The configurable admin panel below supports both modes simultaneously
PRATING.MIGRATION_NOTE_5: • No system rebuild required — the P-level thresholds become "bracket labels" on the same underlying 0–100 score
PRATING.ADMIN_CONFIG_SUB: All thresholds are adjustable — changes take effect immediately across all calculations
PRATING.DEMO_TALKING_POINT: Demo talking point: "Your team can adjust every threshold from here. As you fine-tune the norms, the system adapts immediately — no code changes required." Only P8 = 100% is locked (confirmed by Anand Sir, 8 Apr). All other values are estimates and fully editable.
